title: No PCAP or QMDL
body:
Brand new to this and not exactly the most proficient at Linux. Successfully installed and got RayHunter running on the device however I noticed that all capture files remain empty. Is it safe to say that the SIM I loaded into the device is non-compatible? 
Also the webpage looks similar to the screenshots I've seen however the "live output" area at the top has both human readable time as well as the absolute/computer time. Im thinking that's a browser related thing (Using LIbreWolf)
Thank you for any input! 

Small update. After leaving the device running for awhile one of the PCAP/QMDL files is reporting a file size. However when i go to download it i download an empty file.

comments.body:
Can you please post a screenshot of your web interface? Also please add the contents of the rayhunter.log file which can be gotten with the following commands:
```
adb shell
rootshell
cd /data/rayhunter
cat rayhunter.log
```
